## About

ecoPrimals is sovereign distributed scientific computing in Pure Rust.
No CUDA. No cloud. No vendor lock-in. WebGPU/WGSL for GPU compute.
117 research papers. 16 Rust crates. AGPL-3.0-or-later.

## Key Topics

WebGPU, WGSL, GPU compute, lattice QCD, molecular dynamics, protein structure
prediction, pharmacometrics, bioinformatics, Shannon entropy, Klein bottle
topology, zero-knowledge proofs, mesh networking, post-quantum cryptography,
sovereign computing, self-hosted science, Pure Rust, no CUDA, AGPL-3.0.
